messages:
lina: kicking off a small canary for release v2026.03.2 -> eu-west (5% traffic). please eyeball embed and serve SLOs. rollback rules in release notes: p95 +150ms or 5xx >1.8% for 3m. release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/v2026.03.2

deploy-bot: Canary initiated: id=canary-4421 release=v2026.03.2 region=eu-west traffic=5%

omar: acked. i'll watch the p95 and 5xx panels. if p95 breach persists for 3m i'll call rollback.

jess: quick snapshot from dashboards at 11:04 UTC: embeds/p95=188ms (+60ms), serve/p95=120ms (+18ms), overall 5xx=0.6%. small 502 cluster on proxy-7 between 11:02-11:04.

lina: noted proxy-7. can someone run `logs tail proxy-7 --since 5m` and post a sample?

jess: tail ->
```
2026-02-14T11:02:11Z proxy-7 upstream_error target=embed-serve-03 code=502 conn=reset
2026-02-14T11:02:13Z proxy-7 retrying target=embed-serve-03 attempt=2
2026-02-14T11:03:00Z proxy-7 upstream_timeout target=embed-serve-04
```

sre-bot: Alert: proxy-7 transient 502 spike (5 events in 3m) Severity=low

shaun: looks like a backend pod intermittently failing healthcheck after autoscaler added an instance. starting a kube events query for embed-serve-03/04.

omar: current plan: keep canary at 5% for 10m, monitor. if 5xx hits 1.8% for 3m OR p95 > 300ms we pin to v2026.02.10.

lina: i agree. also toggling the follow-up alert: increase sampling for traces from embed service to catch root cause. `/set alert trace-sampler embed-service 100`

sre-bot: Command accepted: trace-sampler set for embed-service -> 100

deploy-bot: Canary update (4m): traffic=5% p95_embed=190ms errors=0.9% instances=+1 status=observing

jess: p95 still elevated but stable, error rate creeping to 1.2%. no sustained >3m breach yet.

shaun: kube events show `embed-serve-03` OOMKilled at 11:01:58 UTC then restarted; new instance took longer to warm LRU cache causing some timeouts. logs: `OOMKilled: process exceeded memory`

lina: thanks. reduce canary traffic to 2% while we let the new pod warm. `/run deploy-bot adjust-canary --id canary-4421 --traffic 2%`

deploy-bot: Executing adjust-canary: id=canary-4421 new_traffic=2%

omar: good move. warming should reduce tail latency. we'll monitor for 8m and then decide next step.

jess: updating release notes with note about OOM and canary slowdown. link: https://internal.releases/redwood/v2026.03.2#notes

sre-bot: Reminder: mute spammy alert `trace-sample-low` for 15m? (recommended by lina)

lina: yes please mute for 15m: `/mute alert trace-sample-low 15m`

sre-bot: Alert muted: trace-sample-low (muted by lina) expires in 15 minutes.

deploy-bot: Final status (12m): traffic=2% p95_embed=170ms errors=0.7% instances=+1 no rollback triggered. continuing monitoring.

(ongoing watch; will post if thresholds are hit or canary is promoted)
